name: itk

about.summary: ITK is an open-source toolkit for multidimensional image analysis

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.4.7"

package:
  name: itk
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/InsightSoftwareConsortium/ITK/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c953ad7957c481dbb17cfebf03fc61e5252b2be7ccf6757d1234b48ac99914f8
  patches:
    - 0001-BUG-use-check_symbol_exists-for-TIFFFieldReadCount.patch

build:
  number: 0
  # Python wrapping is version-specific; target 3.10-3.12 only.
  # Skip osx-64: the from-source build exceeds the 6h CI cap on Intel runners.
  skip: match(python, "<3.10") or match(python, ">3.12") or (osx and x86_64)

requirements:
  build:
    - cmake >=3.16.3,<3.30.0
    - ninja
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
    - castxml
  host:
    - if: not win
      then: expat
    - fftw
    - hdf5
    - libjpeg-turbo
    - libtiff
    - if: not win
      then: libpng
    - eigen
    - if: not win
      then: zlib
    - tbb-devel
    - python
    - numpy
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - if: not win
      then: expat
    - fftw
    - hdf5
    - libjpeg-turbo
    - libtiff
    - if: not win
      then: libpng
    - eigen
    - if: not win
      then: zlib
    - tbb

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - itk
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python }}
  - files:
      recipe:
        - ITK-JPEG.jpg
        - test_metadata.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python }}
        - numpy
    script:
      - python test_metadata.py ${{ version }}
      # libjpeg-turbo's SIMD IDCT differs by arch: x86_64 (SSE2) and arm64
      # (NEON) decode to different MD5s. Accept both; itkTestDriver passes if
      # the decoded image matches any listed baseline.
      - itkTestDriver --no-process --compare-MD5 ITK-JPEG.jpg 959e1682d19026fc62cfbdc140df31da f3c22ee0eb6402a5eb320fb675112c45

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE
  summary: ITK is an open-source toolkit for multidimensional image analysis
  homepage: https://www.itk.org/
  repository: https://github.com/InsightSoftwareConsortium/ITK
  documentation: https://itk.org/ITK/help/documentation.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewtex
    - hanayik
